title: UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure not accepted
entities.description: Procedure executed when the network rejects UE-initiated authentication and key agreement. The AMF creates and sends a RELAY KEY REJECT message to the UE.

entities.name: RELAY KEY REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE when authentication is rejected. Contains PRTI IE and optionally EAP message IE.

entities.name: RELAY KEY REQUEST
entities.description: Message received from UE initiating authentication procedure.

entities.name: RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message received from UE containing authentication response.

entities.name: PRTI
entities.description: Information element containing PRTI value used in RELAY KEY REJECT message.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Information element containing EAP-failure message when authentication fails.

entities.name: Authentication failed
entities.description: Condition where UE considers authentication has failed upon receiving RELAY KEY REJECT message.

entities.name: PC5 signalling protocol procedure
entities.description: Procedure specified in 3GPP 24.554 subclause 7.2.2.5 that UE performs after authentication failure.

relations.description: AMF creates and sends RELAY KEY REJECT message as part of the procedure
RELAY KEY REJECT message contains PRTI IE
RELAY KEY REJECT message may contain EAP message IE with EAP-failure
Authentication failure condition triggers UE to perform PC5 signalling protocol procedure
Receiving RELAY KEY REJECT message causes UE to consider authentication failed
